summary.plain: Three large magnetic spectrometers, each about 15 metres long and over 200 tonnes, that measure the momentum and direction of scattered electrons and other particles with extreme precision.
summary.technical: A1 three-spectrometer setup: spectrometers of about 15 m and more than 200 t each, momentum resolution better than 0.01%, time resolution of 0.5 ns, vertical drift chambers, scintillators, Cherenkov counters, focal-plane polarimeter; plus the KAOS spectrometer.

technology.quote: The spectrometers of the A1 collaboration are about 15 meters in size and each weighs more than 200 tons.
technology.value: Three high-resolution magnetic spectrometers about 15 m in size, each weighing more than 200 tons
